description: The Partner Tabs interface provides a comprehensive view of a specific partner, organizing all relevant information into distinct, easily navigable sections. Users can access details such as organizational information, contact persons, interaction history, funding agreements, and performance analytics, all from a single, centralized location. This interface is crucial for managing partner relationships and accessing critical data efficiently.

pages.name: PartnerTabsComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing and managing all aspects of a specific partner. It uses a tabbed navigation system to segment information, allowing users to quickly switch between different categories of data without leaving the partner's profile. The top section always displays the partner's logo and basic identifying information, ensuring context is maintained across all tabs.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're looking for specific information about a partner, use the tabs at the top of the page to navigate between different sections. The partner's logo and essential details are always visible at the top for quick reference. Each tab is designed to display a distinct set of information, such as organizational details, contact persons, interaction history, or financial agreements. If you need to update the partner's logo, click on the existing logo area.
common_tasks: Viewing partner details: Click on the 'Details' tab to see the main organizational information.
Managing contacts: Switch to the 'Contacts' tab to view, add, or edit individuals associated with this partner.
Checking interactions: Navigate to the 'Interactions' tab to review communication history and past engagements.
Viewing funding: Go to the 'Funding & Agreements' tab for financial information and contractual details.
Accessing analytics: Use the 'Dashboard' tab to view performance metrics and analytical data related to the partner.
Uploading logo: Click on the partner's logo displayed at the top of the page to upload a new image.
help_guidance.getting_started: To begin, select a partner from the main partners list. This will open their dedicated profile page, which is organized into several tabs. Start by exploring the 'Details' tab for an overview, then proceed to other tabs like 'Contacts' or 'Interactions' based on the information you need. The interface is designed for intuitive navigation between these sections.
